content: Homelessness and housing insecurity create significant challenges for individuals managing diabetes. These challenges include restricted access to safe storage for insulin and other necessary medical supplies, which are critical for effective diabetes management. Additionally, individuals in this population often experience food insecurity, which can complicate maintaining a consistent and appropriate diet essential for blood glucose control. They are also more likely to have low health literacy, which can hinder their ability to understand and follow medical advice or treatment plans. Furthermore, there is a higher prevalence of cognitive and behavioral health issues within this group, which can further impede their ability to manage their diabetes effectively.
